ladder_obligation.benefit_obligation: Fresh-task lift versus a static-method parent. Currently BLOCKED_ON_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION, explicitly not a null.
ladder_obligation.ledger_row: research/mechanism_benefit_ledger/ledger.json MECH-METHOD-EVOLUTION: benefit NOT_ATTEMPTED; 'the single largest benefit gap in the programme'.
ladder_obligation.frontier_binding: research/orion_claim_frontier_v1/CLAIM_FRONTIER.json P3 next_target FRESH_MODEL_INTERFACE_QUALIFICATION_THEN_RAW_TRAJECTORY_CAUSAL_LIFT: a qualification pass authorizes only a separately frozen power-sized matched experiment; it does not itself show the method-evolution mechanic helps.

question: Is the system's capability floor sufficient that a method change COULD express a measurable fresh-task lift? Concretely: does the static-method parent complete a registered fresh-task battery inside a two-sided headroom window with non-degenerate variance, on an instrument whose gold labels are structurally independent of predictions, with episodes/lessons demonstrably reaching the routing surface and enough relevant experience existing for a method-evolution arm to have anything to leverage?

defect_register_this_design_avoids.L6_gold_is_the_prediction: ladder.json L6 readiness evidence: 'Four of six Paper III gate conditions NON_FALSIFIABLE; gold label is the prediction (same pure function, same argument). Registered thresholds sit exactly at the ceilings.' Countermeasures here: (a) gold minted only by a hidden-world generator or by the separate independent oracle module under the PR #634 independence contract (no import, no call, enumerated forbidden inputs, gold committed before any parent run); (b) every qualification gate threshold is strictly interior to the achievable range and each gate is demonstrated flippable by a planted evaluator selftest world; (c) a run-level gate-falsifiability audit (research/paper3_gate_falsifiability_audit_v1 battery pattern) is a registered execution obligation - a zero-variance gate is an instrument defect, not a pass.
defect_register_this_design_avoids.paper3_model_level_experience_negative: research/orion_p1_p4_closure_v2/README.md preserves the historical model-level experience negative; research/empirical_10_of_10_v1/CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION Stage 1 localized the class: an undefined evidence-role instruction surface made 'cannot bind evidence' and 'answered under the other admissible reading' unidentifiable, so a lift-style negative was uninterpretable. Countermeasure: QC1 runs the Stage-0-style role-semantics audit (audit input is instruction text only, never outcomes) BEFORE any parent metric is read; failure is CANNOT_CHECK(INSTRUMENT_DEFECT), never NOT_QUALIFIED and never a capability claim.
defect_register_this_design_avoids.non_falsifiable_successor_gates: research/paper3_gate_falsifiability_audit_v1/GATE_FALSIFIABILITY_AUDIT.json: typed_exact/typed_unsafe/typed_cannot_check/typed_legitimate_apply were NON_FALSIFIABLE (zero-variance under 9 probes x 32 trials). Successor gates here use interior windows (QC2, QC3, QC4, QC6) or conformance gates with planted failing worlds (QC5, QC7, QC8).

subject_binding.subject: The static-method parent: the promoted RAKL mechanics with method evolution OFF - SearchPolicy(version='static-parent-v1') at the frozen defaults of src/rakl/search_policy_learning.SearchPolicy, no episode-store consultation, no lesson application, no experience-conditioned routing - over a role-defined task interface.
subject_binding.execution_precondition: SUBJECT_FREEZE required BEFORE battery generation: exact model id/revision/decoding/resource + interface hash frozen either by issue #447 Stage-3 freeze (research/empirical_10_of_10_v1/CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION, currently proposal-only) or by an L6-specific SUBJECT_FREEZE_V1.json committed first. No RAKL treatment outcome may participate in subject selection (CLAIM_FRONTIER P3 promotion_gate: no threshold/model shopping). An unfrozen subject at evaluation time is CANNOT_CHECK(SUBJECT_NOT_FROZEN).
subject_binding.relation_to_447: Deliberately consumes the #447 Stage-0/Stage-2 instrument discipline and does not fork it: the merged Stage-2 role-defined interface and pre-frozen candidate model set are the strongest fair parents (CLAIM_FRONTIER P3 strongest_parent). This protocol adds the L6-specific coordinates (#QC5-QC7) that #447 does not cover.

family_sources.families_1_to_11: The eleven Stage-4 panel families (experiments/paper3/build_capability_stage4_panel_v1.py), regenerated fresh with a new registered seed; gold minted by the generator's hidden world at generation time, never by any arm.
family_sources.family_12: Fresh structured routing records over the 14 candidate-visible fields of research/paper3_independent_oracle_action_v1/PROTOCOL.json; gold computed by experiments/paper3/independent_action_oracle_v1.oracle_action (merged PR #634, structurally independent of the shipped candidate). Role: end-to-end liveness of the routing surface inside the scored path; expected near-ceiling for the parent and therefore expected to occupy one of the four QC4 out-of-window slots.

battery.scoring: Known-answer or independently-oracled scoring ONLY. Hardened Stage-5 scorer discipline (experiments/paper3/run_capability_stage4_v2._score): gold denominators unconditional on model behavior; an incomplete evidence partition cannot remove itself from a hard-metric denominator; refusal/timeout/malformed output = failure in the all-N denominator; declared CANNOT_CHECK is correct only when gold is CANNOT_CHECK.
battery.generation: Seeded parametric generator, no network, no LLM labeling. Generator seed and family list registered before the episode store is read; the only corpus read during generation is the QC7 exclusion check. 10% human audit (24 tasks) sampled by seed; the auditor sees only rendered task text and gold, never any arm output (auditor_saw_arm_outputs must be false; disagreement >= 0.05 is CANNOT_CHECK).
battery.freshness_semantics: Freshness is instance-level, not family-level. Family-level overlap with the experience corpus is REQUIRED on purpose (a method-evolution arm can only express lift where experience is relevant); instance-level freshness is what makes the eventual claim a fresh-task claim.

freshness_check.checked_against: research/self_rakl_seed_corpus_v1/seed_corpus.jsonl at frozen head 7113f24bbed5b93c0197069078fff9e7189dee0b912fd7d65e35ef16e4c55396 (139 episodes, all PROPOSAL_SHADOW_STORED, PR #651).
procedure: For every battery task: task_content_hash = sha256(canonical task JSON without gold); EpisodeStore.find_by_artifact_hash(task_content_hash) must be empty.
No stored episode problem_signature tuple may exactly equal a task's problem_signature tuple (exact structural check, never embedding or lexical similarity).
Battery task ids disjoint from all stored episode_ids.
Battery minted after the store freeze; the store head hash the check ran against is recorded in the bundle and must equal the frozen head.
freshness_check.tolerance: Zero. One contaminated instance fails QC7; remediation regenerates exactly the contaminated instances under a fresh registered seed block, preserving the contaminated ids in the receipt.

routing_surface_reachability.purpose: The L6 blocker is only lifted if episodes/lessons demonstrably REACH the routing surface; otherwise a lift experiment measures a mechanism that is not connected.
receipts_required: EpisodeStore(research/self_rakl_seed_corpus_v1/seed_corpus.jsonl) opens with verify VALID and head == frozen head; episodes_shadow_count == 139; zero admission upgrades detected before/after all reads (shadow stays shadow; byte-identical store).

Registered query battery - episodes(), episodes_by_outcome(SUCCESS), episodes_in_time_range(full corpus range), find_by_artifact_hash(known hash) - returns non-empty, deterministic results across two independent runs.

Content sensitivity: >= 14 registered flip pairs (>= 1 per candidate-visible routing field of the PR #634 record schema). Each pair derives a structured routing state from stored episode content, passes it to the promoted structured experience-to-action mechanic, then flips exactly one load-bearing field and requires the returned action to change. All pairs must flip: proves the routing surface consumes episode-derived content rather than decoration.
routing_surface_reachability.boundary: These receipts use SHADOW episodes as inputs to a reachability check only. PROPOSAL_SHADOW_STORED never satisfies canonical inventory, promotion, lesson/tool, proof or root gates (src/rakl/experience_substrate.TaskEpisode contract), and this check cannot upgrade them.

QC1_INSTRUMENT_VALIDITY.gate: Role-semantics audit passed on instruction text only; gold-independence receipts clean (oracle present, no candidate import, no oracle output fed to candidate, forbidden inputs absent, gold committed before parent run); human audit blind to arm outputs with disagreement < 0.05.
QC1_INSTRUMENT_VALIDITY.on_violation: CANNOT_CHECK(INSTRUMENT_DEFECT) - parent metrics are not interpreted (mirrors research/paper3_independent_oracle_action_v1 instrument_terminal).
QC1_INSTRUMENT_VALIDITY.justification: Direct countermeasure to the two registered defect classes above; checked FIRST so an instrument defect can never be read as a capability result.

QC2_PARENT_COMPLETION_WINDOW.gate: Parent battery completion rate p_hat in [0.20, 0.80] on the all-N denominator; if the exact Clopper-Pearson 95% CI contains a window edge the coordinate is CANNOT_CHECK(QC2_EDGE_INDETERMINATE) with a registered +120-task extension (same generator, new seed block) - pre-registered precision step, not post-hoc rescue.
QC2_PARENT_COMPLETION_WINDOW.justification: Below 0.20 the failure mass is attributable to base capability, not method: a method change modulates HOW the system searches, and 0->0 outcomes carry no method information (this is exactly the uninterpretability the L6 blocker names). Above 0.80 ceiling compression shrinks the discordant-pair mass and the maximum expressible lift falls under the 0.10 target with degraded McNemar power. N=240 puts the 95% CI half-width near 0.05-0.06, so the window is decidable except within one half-width of an edge. Both PASS and FAIL are reachable (interior thresholds; planted selftest worlds at 0.10 and 0.95).

QC3_NON_DEGENERATE_VARIANCE.gate: >= 8 of 12 families strictly mixed (0 < successes < 20) AND structured-readout validity >= 0.90.
QC3_NON_DEGENERATE_VARIANCE.justification: A lift estimator needs within-family outcome variance; up to 4 families may be legitimately degenerate (deliberately easy/hard anchors plus family 12 near ceiling). Readout floor 0.90: the Stage-1 diagnosis showed parse was NOT the bottleneck at 5/5 - if readout collapses the measurement is dominated by interface failure and must be repaired there, not read as capability.

QC4_PER_FAMILY_HEADROOM.gate: >= 8 of 12 families with family completion rate in [0.10, 0.90].
QC4_PER_FAMILY_HEADROOM.justification: The lift experiment needs per-family reads (which method surfaces improved); headroom in at least two-thirds of strata keeps those reads informative. Family 12 is expected to occupy an out-of-window slot by design.

QC5_ROUTING_SURFACE_REACHABILITY.gate: Store integrity + snapshot receipts clean (else CANNOT_CHECK); query battery deterministic and non-empty; all >= 14 registered content-sensitivity flip pairs flip.
QC5_ROUTING_SURFACE_REACHABILITY.justification: Conformance gate, exact by design (like PR #634 all-mutants-caught, which the falsifiability audit rated FALSIFIABLE); a planted selftest world with 27/28 flips fails it. Failure is an operational routing defect, never a capability negative.

QC6_EXPERIENCE_RELEVANCE_COVERAGE.gate: >= 50% of battery families have >= 1 stored episode whose problem_signature contains the family's registered signature token (exact token mapping, registered before execution), AND >= 1 family has an episode with a verified (SUCCESS) outcome.
QC6_EXPERIENCE_RELEVANCE_COVERAGE.justification: A method-evolution arm can only leverage experience that exists: below half coverage a lift null is attributable to experience starvation, not method inefficacy. The verified-outcome floor is 1 because APPLY_VERIFIED_LESSON routing is gated on verified lessons; the seed corpus currently holds only 2 SUCCESS / 137 UNKNOWN outcomes (research/self_rakl_seed_corpus_v1/MIGRATION_RECEIPT.md), so this coordinate is expected to be the binding constraint and its remediation lever (typed outcome backfill, migration V2 per receipt residual 3) is registered in advance.

QC7_FRESHNESS.gate: Zero contaminated instances under the freshness_check procedure, verified against the frozen store head.
QC7_FRESHNESS.justification: Freshness is definitional for the fresh-task claim; it is a rate-zero gate with a cheap total remediation (regenerate the exact contaminated instances), so zero tolerance does not create a dead end.

QC8_COST_TELEMETRY.gate: Per-task cost receipts (wall_ms; tokens when a model interface is the subject; peak RSS) present for 100% of parent runs, with >= 2 distinct values and not all zero.
QC8_COST_TELEMETRY.justification: The lift experiment must charge all costs (matched budgets); qualification verifies the cost instrument works before the experiment that depends on it.

typed_outcomes.QUALIFIED: All coordinates PASS. Authorizes ONLY the freezing of L6-LIFT-V1 (a separate future protocol). Explicitly NOT a lift, NOT a benefit, NOT model efficacy, NOT scientific authority; ladder.json is not edited by this outcome.
typed_outcomes.NOT_QUALIFIED: Coordinate list; every failed coordinate names the floor condition, the measured value, and its registered remediation lever (frozen in EVALUATOR.py REMEDIATION). Per the global-recovery doctrine each failure is intermediate: one attributed revival iteration per failed coordinate (single-stage attribution first), re-frozen as V2 with the V1 receipt preserved verbatim.
typed_outcomes.CANNOT_CHECK: Typed reasons (INSTRUMENT_DEFECT:*, SUBJECT_NOT_FROZEN, STORE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE, STORE_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH, SHADOW_POSTURE_VIOLATED, FRESHNESS_CHECK_WRONG_SNAPSHOT, QC2_EDGE_INDETERMINATE, MISSING_SECTION:*, BATTERY_STRUCTURE:*). Never conflated with NOT_QUALIFIED and never with 'checked and fine'. Evaluator exit code 3, distinct from evaluated 0.

evaluator.selftest: python3 research/l6_capability_qualification_v1/EVALUATOR.py --selftest (verified PASS at freeze: clean world QUALIFIED; one planted FAIL world per gate; typed CANNOT_CHECK worlds; determinism byte-identical).
evaluator.purity: Deterministic, stdlib-only, no I/O beyond the bundle read; consumes scored booleans and receipts, never gold or raw predictions.
evaluator.no_post_result_rescue: Thresholds, family list, store binding, and evaluator are frozen at this commit; any change after result access voids the run (invariant no_post_result_threshold_rescue).

lift_experiment_design_sketch.status: SKETCH_ONLY - frozen separately as L6-LIFT-V1 only after a QUALIFIED outcome; recorded here so qualification measures the right floor.
lift_experiment_design_sketch.design: Paired within-task across arms on a FRESH battery draw (new seed block, disjoint instances, same generator and freshness check; qualification instances are burned).

arms.A_static_parent: Identical subject to this qualification's parent (same frozen SUBJECT_FREEZE identity).
arms.B_method_evolution: Identical except the method-evolution mechanic is ON: experience-conditioned routing via the promoted structured experience-to-action mechanic, verified-lesson application, and search-policy deltas derived through the registered flow (src/rakl/search_policy_learning derive_search_policy_update / materialize_search_policy_challenger). This IS the method change under test.
arms.C_sham_experience: B's machinery over a permuted-content placebo store (same size, same cost); separates mechanism from scaffolding/overhead (clean-baseline + shuffle-null discipline).
arms.D_episodes_only: B without verified-lesson gating (raw retrieval); attributes lesson-gating value beyond retrieval.

lift_experiment_design_sketch.primary_contrast: B vs A completion delta, McNemar exact on discordant pairs, two-sided. Attribution contrasts: B vs C (mechanism beyond placebo), B vs D (gating beyond retrieval).
lift_experiment_design_sketch.power_sketch: Target lift 0.10 absolute at alpha 0.05 two-sided, power 0.80. With discordant-pair probabilities p10=0.12, p01=0.02, n ~= (1.96*sqrt(0.14) + 0.84*sqrt(0.13))^2 / 0.01 ~= 107 pairs; N_lift = 300 paired tasks gives ~3x margin, supports per-family reads, and protects the smaller B-vs-C effect. QC2's window guarantees the parent rate this calculation assumes.
lift_experiment_design_sketch.matched_budgets: Identical model id/revision/decoding, identical wall-clock and token caps, identical retrieval surfaces except the experience store; arms B/C/D are charged store-query and consolidation costs in the receipt (all costs charged).
lift_experiment_design_sketch.suppression_guard: The method-change arm must not win by task refusal: all-N denominators fixed by the battery; refusal/timeout/malformed = failure; declared CANNOT_CHECK correct only when gold is CANNOT_CHECK (the battery's gold-CANNOT_CHECK family makes abstention measurable in both directions); if any arm's non-gold CANNOT_CHECK rate exceeds the parent's by > 0.05 absolute, the outcome cannot be PROMOTE regardless of the primary contrast.

rshea_pipeline: process_telemetry_to_receipts (src/rakl/observability_adapters.py) over subject-freeze, battery-generation, freshness-check, store-reachability, parent-run and evaluator events
MetricLedger (src/rakl/evolution_trace.py) + build_evaluation_epoch + process_outcome_gate (src/rakl/observability_adapters.py) - hard gates executed, not logged
interpret_controller_for_runtime (src/rakl/self_hosting_bridge.py) - SELECTED maps to OBJECT_SEARCH_READY, never authority
surface_governed_proposal (src/rakl/governed_intervention.py) - any ladder.json edit requires external GovernanceSignOff in a separate PR; sign-off is continuation, never promotion

non_claims: Qualification is not lift: a QUALIFIED outcome demonstrates the floor conditions for an interpretable lift experiment, not any benefit of method evolution.
Passing gates is not benefit: every gate here is a precondition check on the parent and the instrument, none measures the method-evolution mechanic's value.

Shadow episodes stay shadow: PROPOSAL_SHADOW_STORED is consumed read-only for reachability/relevance/freshness receipts and is never upgraded, counted toward canonical inventory, or used to satisfy promotion/lesson/tool/proof gates.
ladder.json is untouched by this study; benefit_measured/readiness fields change only via a separate governed PR after the LIFT experiment, never after qualification.
No framework module is modified; the historical L6 gate negatives, the Paper III model-level experience negative, and the #447 Stage-0/1 findings remain immutable and are cited, not rewritten.
